name: Kokoro-82M
purpose: Small, fast and cheap TTS with 'comparable quality to larger models' (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE in https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro read: Apache License 2.0 (commercial use, redistribution and patent grant with notice).

architecture.kind: NON-AUTOREGRESSIVE StyleTTS 2 + ISTFTNet decoder, no diffusion (not an LLM; CPU-friendly)

weaknesses: German not named on the card (v1.0 has 8 languages)
Trained on a few hundred hours, some synthetic data

tona_fit.reason: Quality for its size is the benchmark for tiny TTS and Apache-2.0 fits every class, but German is not supported: the official lang_code list (kokoro/pipeline.py) has American/British English, es, fr, hi, it, pt-br, ja, zh and VOICES.md has no German voice. Fine for English/other readout; for German users use a German-capable model.
blockers: no German voice (lang codes a,b,e,f,h,i,p,j,z only)

open_questions: Community German ports exist (Kokoro-82M-German CoreML conversions by a third party, 2026-10); quality and license of their training data not checked
